assumptions.statement: Official site/key-area polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage, utilities, accessibility conditions, and engineering constraints are not present in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: All spatial positions and calculated areas remain provisional concept indexes and must be recomputed before statutory or site-specific use.

assumptions.statement: The protection receipt, four-role accountability model, temporary route, and no-fault remedy are proposed governance mechanisms, not existing legal entitlements.
assumptions.impact: Legal, public-service, accessibility, privacy, cybersecurity, and emergency-safety professionals must define authority before any real pilot.

assumptions.statement: Six conflict cases use fictional instructions and actors; no real case, personal data, institutional operational record, or field performance result is claimed.
assumptions.impact: Protocol counts demonstrate scope only and cannot be interpreted as effectiveness evidence.
